# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Two lists rather than one: the nine an age-3 advance gives everybody, and the
# handful that belong to one country or culture. Ticking either is one answer,
# the way the two goods lists are.

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_register_right_common_list = {
	cmm_register_settings_list = {
		mod_id = bag_wtp
		setting_id = right_common
		tab_id = goods
		item_count = 9
		is_ordered = 0
	}

	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 1 value = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights }
	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 2 value = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights }
	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 3 value = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights }

	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 7 value = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights }
	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 8 value = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights }
	cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 9 value = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights }

	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__right_common_i1_name value = flag:bag_wtp_right_royal_artisan_rights }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__right_common_i2_name value = flag:bag_wtp_right_royal_book_rights }

	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__right_common_i6_name value = flag:bag_wtp_right_royal_naval_rights }

	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__right_common_i9_name value = flag:bag_wtp_right_royal_weaponry_rights }

		mod_id = bag_wtp

	cmm_register_settings_list = {

	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__right_unique_i1_name value = flag:bag_wtp_right_constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__right_unique_i2_name value = flag:bag_wtp_right_scandinavian_bergslag_privileges }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp__right_unique_i3_name value = flag:bag_wtp_right_scandinavian_tar_privileges }

	cmm_register_list_bool_field = {
		mod_id = bag_wtp
		setting_id = right_unique
		field_id = pick
		default_value = 0
	}
}


# Which right is ticked, settled exactly as the good is: a tick that is not the
# stored answer is the new answer, and nothing ticked at all means the player
# unticked the one that was.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_read_right = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ticks value = 0 }
	cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__right_common field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_right_ticked }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_right_ticked
		root = { change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ticks add = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 2 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 2 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 3 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 3 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 4 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 4 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 5 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 5 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 6 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 6 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 7 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 7 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 8 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 8 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 9 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 9 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 10 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 10 } } } }
	}
	cmm_build_list_bool_list = { setting = bag_wtp__right_unique field_slot = 1 list_name = bag_wtp_right_ticked }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_right_ticked
		root = { change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_ticks add = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 1 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 1 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:scandinavian_bergslag_privileges } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 11 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 11 } } } }
		if = { limit = { this = town_rights_type:scandinavian_tar_privileges } root = { if = { limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 12 } } set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_new value = 12 } } } }
	}


	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_new > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_index value = var:bag_wtp_right_new }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_ticks = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_index value = 0 }
	}

	# Readable from a location's own scope, where a country variable is not.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_right_index value = var:bag_wtp_right_index }
}

# Force every row but the answer off.

# What this country is offered.
#
# The nine general ones stay on the page whatever the age: they are everybody's,
# one advance away, and this mod is for planning ahead -- hiding them until age
# three would leave an empty list where the answer belongs. **A unique right is
# another matter.** Wallachia has no business being shown Constantinople's silk
# monopoly, and the game already says so: the monopoly carries
# `potential = { OR = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ has_or_had_tag = ROM } }` and the
# Scandinavian privileges carry an advance nobody else takes. Both are asked
# here, and neither is this mod's opinion about who owns what.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_refresh_rights = {
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 3 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 4 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 6 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 7 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 8 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = yes }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 9 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_common item = 9 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { OR = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ has_or_had_tag = ROM } } }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_unique item = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_unique item = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:scandinavian_group } } }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_unique item = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_unique item = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AND = { culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:scandinavian_group } } }
		cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_unique item = 3 }
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = bag_wtp setting_id = right_unique item = 3 }
	}
}

# Score every candidate for the ticked right.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_score_right = {
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 1 } bag_wtp_score_right_1 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 2 } bag_wtp_score_right_2 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 3 } bag_wtp_score_right_3 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 4 } bag_wtp_score_right_4 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 5 } bag_wtp_score_right_5 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 6 } bag_wtp_score_right_6 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 7 } bag_wtp_score_right_7 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 8 } bag_wtp_score_right_8 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 9 } bag_wtp_score_right_9 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 10 } bag_wtp_score_right_10 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 11 } bag_wtp_score_right_11 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_right_index = 12 } bag_wtp_score_right_12 = yes }
}

# constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights -- cloth +25%, fine_cloth +10%, silk +50%
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_score_right_1 = {
	save_scope_as = bag_wtp_country
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_3 value = 0 }
	}

	# cloth: price 3 x (1 + 0.25)
	bag_wtp_score_29 = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **A right obeys the same two buttons as a good.** «Считать» reads the
		# answer available today, «На конец» the one that survives every advance.
		# The twenty-second run pressed the second and got the first, because this
		# read `_best_method` and nothing else.
		#
		# The fallbacks are the same too: a slot the ground feeds nothing keeps its
		# building and its icon and says 0.00%, and `_val` stays 0, so it is worth
		# nothing to the ranking and a row of nothing but those still goes.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_end_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		# And the road there, summed the same way. It only ever breaks a tie, and
		# the ties it breaks are the ones «На конец» leaves: where nothing that
		# survives can be fed, every province in the table is worth exactly zero.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 multiply = 0.3750 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_mid_1 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 multiply = 0.3750 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_val_1 }
	}

	# fine_cloth: price 6 x (1 + 0.1)
	bag_wtp_score_30 = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **A right obeys the same two buttons as a good.** «Считать» reads the
		# answer available today, «На конец» the one that survives every advance.
		# The twenty-second run pressed the second and got the first, because this
		# read `_best_method` and nothing else.
		#
		# The fallbacks are the same too: a slot the ground feeds nothing keeps its
		# building and its icon and says 0.00%, and `_val` stays 0, so it is worth
		# nothing to the ranking and a row of nothing but those still goes.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_end_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		# And the road there, summed the same way. It only ever breaks a tie, and
		# the ties it breaks are the ones «На конец» leaves: where nothing that

			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_3 = 0 }

			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_3 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_3 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_3 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {

# royal_naval_rights -- naval_supplies +30%, tar +30%
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_score_right_7 = {
	save_scope_as = bag_wtp_country
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_3 value = 0 }
	}

	# naval_supplies: price 3 x (1 + 0.3)
	bag_wtp_score_39 = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **A right obeys the same two buttons as a good.** «Считать» reads the
		# answer available today, «На конец» the one that survives every advance.
		# The twenty-second run pressed the second and got the first, because this
		# read `_best_method` and nothing else.
		#
		# The fallbacks are the same too: a slot the ground feeds nothing keeps its
		# building and its icon and says 0.00%, and `_val` stays 0, so it is worth
		# nothing to the ranking and a row of nothing but those still goes.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_end_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		# And the road there, summed the same way. It only ever breaks a tie, and
		# the ties it breaks are the ones «На конец» leaves: where nothing that
		# survives can be fed, every province in the table is worth exactly zero.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 multiply = 0.3900 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_mid_1 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 multiply = 0.3900 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_val_1 }
	}

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_end_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }

# royal_weaponry_rights -- cannons +20%, firearms +20%, weaponry +20%
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_score_right_10 = {
	save_scope_as = bag_wtp_country
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_3 value = 0 }
	}

	# cannons: price 4 x (1 + 0.2)
	bag_wtp_score_28 = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **A right obeys the same two buttons as a good.** «Считать» reads the
		# answer available today, «На конец» the one that survives every advance.
		# The twenty-second run pressed the second and got the first, because this
		# read `_best_method` and nothing else.
		#
		# The fallbacks are the same too: a slot the ground feeds nothing keeps its
		# building and its icon and says 0.00%, and `_val` stays 0, so it is worth
		# nothing to the ranking and a row of nothing but those still goes.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_rank_by_end } }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_end_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_1 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		# And the road there, summed the same way. It only ever breaks a tie, and
		# the ties it breaks are the ones «На конец» leaves: where nothing that
		# survives can be fed, every province in the table is worth exactly zero.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_1 multiply = 0.4800 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_mid_1 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_1 multiply = 0.4800 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_val_1 }
	}

			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_end_best }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_rural }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_method_2 value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }
			}
		}
		# And the road there, summed the same way. It only ever breaks a tie, and
		# the ties it breaks are the ones «На конец» leaves: where nothing that
		# survives can be fed, every province in the table is worth exactly zero.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_2 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural > var:bag_wtp_mid_best }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_2 value = var:bag_wtp_mid_best_rural }
		}
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_2 multiply = 0.2400 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_mid_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_mid_2 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_val_2 multiply = 0.2400 }
		change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_total add = var:bag_wtp_r_val_2 }
	}
}

# Scratch into slot 1.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_slot_1_from_scratch = {
	clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_r_goods_1
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_bt_1
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_pm_1
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_bonus_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_out_1 value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_goods_all_1 value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_w_bt }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_bt_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_bt }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_pm_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_pm }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_bonus_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_bonus }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_out_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_out }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_goods_all_1 value = var:bag_wtp_w_goods_all }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_w_goods
			prev = { add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_r_goods_1 target = prev } }
		}
	}
}

# The goods of the ticked right, parked on the winning location so the row can
# name them. Written per row rather than per candidate, like everything else
# here.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_right_goods = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:cloth }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:fine_cloth }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:silk }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:furniture }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:leather }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:pottery }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:books }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:dyes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:paper }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:beer }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:liquor }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:wine }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:jewelry }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_2
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:glass }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:masonry }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:naval_supplies }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:tar }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:cloth }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:dyes }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:fine_cloth }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 9 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:tools }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_2
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:cannons }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:firearms }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_3 value = goods:weaponry }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 11 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:tools }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_2
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_right_index = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_1 value = goods:naval_supplies }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_good_2 value = goods:tar }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_r_good_3
	}
}

# Park the whole answer for one province, slot by slot.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_right_row = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_method value = var:bag_wtp_r_method_1 }
	bag_wtp_store_scratch = yes
	bag_wtp_slot_1_from_scratch = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_method value = var:bag_wtp_r_method_2 }
	bag_wtp_store_scratch = yes
	bag_wtp_slot_2_from_scratch = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_w_method value = var:bag_wtp_r_method_3 }
	bag_wtp_store_scratch = yes
	bag_wtp_slot_3_from_scratch = yes
	bag_wtp_store_right_goods = yes
	# What the row prints: the ranking number back in the unit it names, which is
	# what one level of the whole bundle would earn here.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_value value = var:bag_wtp_r_total }
	change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_r_value divide = 100 }
}

# The ranking pass for a right. One row per province definition, as for a good,
# and the same fifty.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_fill_rows_right = {
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_r_score
		max = 400
		check_range_bounds = no
		bag_wtp_store_right_row_if_worth_it = yes
	}
}

# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_right_row_if_worth_it = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_found < 50
			# Nothing in the bundle can be made here at all.
			var:bag_wtp_r_total > 0
			NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_row_taken }
		}
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_row_taken value = 1 }
				add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_row_taken_locations target = this }
			}
		}
		# The winners are parked before the province is judged: «is this ground
		# worth a row» is a question about the bonuses, and a bonus is not known
		# until the method that won it is.
		bag_wtp_store_right_row = yes
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_right_row_is_worth_it = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_found add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rank value = global_var:bag_wtp_found }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_ranked target = this }
		}
	}
}
